mission: Get people drawing together, finding friends, sharing artwork; kids-to-young-adults on tablets.

auto_apply: verifiable by screenshot or existing tests
gate_rules.escalation: Anything else goes to human_review with a note; rejected cards stay rejected unless NEW evidence appears.

backlog.title: Occupancy truth: live painter counts on /rooms cards + home
backlog.description: Show real-time painter occupancy on every room card (/rooms, home hero, marketing strip) so 'Be the first!' lies disappear. Server already tracks users per room; surface it live.
backlog.gate: OVER EFFORT GATE (3 > 2); touches WS protocol + multiple pages

backlog.title: Founding Artist empty-wall inversion
backlog.description: Make /wall's empty state an invitation: 'Be the Founding Artist' with a direct path to draw something destined for the wall. Includes redesign of the dead 2/3 whitespace S2 found.
backlog.gate: OVER EFFORT GATE (3 > 2); copy + layout redesign

backlog.title: Timelapse replay on wall
backlog.description: Replay how a wall piece was drawn, stroke by stroke, from the existing op-log series (src/utils/replay.js).
backlog.gate: OVER EFFORT GATE (4 > 2); playback UI + data plumbing

ready.title: Print the room code ON the /rooms card in big kid-readable type
ready.description: Room codes are currently hidden behind clicks; kids can't tell a friend the code aloud. Render the code in large unambiguous type directly on each /rooms card.
ready.gate: PASS: reversible render-only change in RoomFinderPage.jsx, screenshot-verifiable, effort 1

ready.title: Onboarding panel step 4: 'make it together' using existing overlay
ready.description: Add a final onboarding step that teaches inviting/joining friends, reusing the existing overlay component pattern.
ready.gate: PASS: additive UI, reversible, screenshot-verifiable, effort 1

ready.title: Wall-to-room stub: rooms-behind-pins strip on /wall + wall strip on /rooms
ready.description: Hand-built static cross-links connecting wall pins to the rooms that made them and vice versa; makes the social graph between surfaces visible. Static links only.
ready.gate: PASS: static reversible links, screenshot-verifiable, effort 1. Sequence AFTER CARD-001 so linked rooms aren't all empty.

ready.title: Doomsday nudge: countdown toast gains 'Pin to Wall' at T-2h
ready.description: The unexplained 'Fresh canvas in 2d 23h' badge S2 found becomes a call-to-action: when a room's reset is <2h away, its toast offers Pin-to-Wall so artwork is saved socially.
ready.gate: PASS with caution: reversible UI, no auth/payment/migration/CI, screenshot-verifiable; verify pin flow needs no account

ready.title: Wall dead-cue fix: hide 'Search 0 drawings...' and sort tabs when wall is empty
ready.description: S2: over zero items the wall still shows an enabled search box and sort tabs — dead cues implying missing content. Hide them in the empty state; also fix wall subtitle referencing a 'Wall' button not on that page.
ready.gate: PASS: reversible conditional render in WallPage.jsx, screenshot-verifiable, effort 1

ready.title: Signup: keep 'Keep drawing as a guest →' visible without scrolling on phone
ready.description: S2: on a 375px phone the guest escape hatch crops below the fold, making signup feel mandatory — violates the anonymous-first golden rule's spirit. Reorder/compact so the escape hatch is above the fold.
ready.gate: PASS: reversible layout change in SignupPage.jsx, screenshot-verifiable at 375px, effort 1

done.status_note: SELECTED for cycle 1 (see selection below). Auto-apply gate passed: reversible, no auth/payment/migration/CI, screenshot-verifiable, effort 1.

done.title: Commons routing: first 'Draw now' click lands everyone in MAIN (Open Studio)
done.description: Today HomePage.startRoom mints a random 6-char room per click and SiteNav 'Draw now' links to a random /join/{code}, so first-time visitors each land alone in an empty private room (S2: '0 drawing now', 'Be the first!'). Phase 1 (this card): first-time/anonymous-primary entry points route to /join/MAIN — the already-existing shared room — so strangers land on the SAME canvas and can actually meet. Phase 2 (superset, ex-S3 #6 'full inversion'): route to the most lived-in room once occupancy data exists. Pure routing change: verified startRoom at HomePage.jsx:285 and SiteNav.jsx:101.
done.gate: PASS: reversible (restore random code), no auth/payment/migration/CI, screenshot-verifiable (two sessions both land on room MAIN), effort 1
done.source: S3 #1 + #6 (merged: #6 is the phased superset of #1)

done.title: Truth-in-copy: homepage no longer says 'a fresh canvas starts with just you' after CARD-001
done.description: CARD-001 routed every startRoom entry point to /join/MAIN (public Open Studio), but homepage copy still misdescribes the behavior: HomePage.jsx:351 blank-canvas choice says 'Start with a fresh canvas' and :410 invite-steps says 'Open a room. A fresh canvas starts with just you.' Both now land a kid in a PUBLIC shared room while the copy promises solitude — a copy-behavior mismatch created by our own cycle-1 patch (flagged as follow-up risk by S5/S6). Update the strings (and audit adjacent startRoom copy: 'Make a room and invite friends', 'Create a room', hero 'Start drawing') to honestly describe landing in the shared Open Studio canvas. Copy-only JSX/string change.
done.gate: PASS: copy-only string edits in HomePage.jsx, reversible, no auth/payment/migration/CI, screenshot-verifiable on home tablet+phone, effort 1
done.source: Cycle-2 capture diff (6 changed frames) + S5/S6 cycle-1 follow-up risk; verified HomePage.jsx:351,410

human_review.title: Twitch-pattern counted watchers + emotes
human_review.description: Show spectator counts and let watchers emote — the biggest 'attract watchers' lever (impact 9) but effort 5, new WS message types, and a moderation surface for a kids-to-young-adults audience.
human_review.gate: FAILS: effort 5 > 2; new realtime protocol + emoji-moderation surface on a minors-heavy app
human_review.review_note: Needs human call on moderation policy (emote set, rate limits) and protocol budget before any build.

human_review.title: Public spectate without admin key (/watch open to all)
human_review.description: Currently /watch is admin-key gated; zero public spectator surface (S2). Opening it is high impact for 'attract watchers' but changes who can see kids' live drawing sessions.
human_review.gate: FAILS: effort 5 > 2; safety/moderation surface (minors live on camera-equivalent), potential privacy policy implications
human_review.review_note: Owner must decide: opt-in per room? guardians? This is a product/safety decision, not an auto-apply patch.

selection.rationale: Cycle-1's CARD-001 changed behavior (all 'Draw now' entry points now land in the public MAIN/Open Studio room) but left homepage copy promising a private fresh canvas ('Start with a fresh canvas', 'A fresh canvas starts with just you') — the loop must keep its own change honest before stacking new ones, exactly the follow-up risk S5/S6 flagged and the cycle-2 capture confirms on both tablet and phone home frames. Copy-only, effort 1, fully gate-passing; score 18 also beats CARD-006 (16) and CARD-007 (15), and only trails CARD-002 (36)/CARD-003 (30)/CARD-004 (30), which remain queued for cycle 3. Budget: patch 2 of 5 today.
selection.budget_note: 5 auto-patches/day; 2 used after this selection. Cycle 2 of 3. CARD-002 (36), CARD-003 (30), CARD-004 (30) top the cycle-3 queue by (impact x surprise)/effort.
